linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04+ / SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • Storage: 530 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated (ALSA or PulseAudio compatible)
  • VR Support: Not supported
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 / SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1600 or Intel Core i5-8400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • Storage: 530 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated (ALSA or PulseAudio compatible)
  • VR Support: Not supported

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 High Sierra
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or Apple M1 (Rosetta or native)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 6000 / Radeon R9 M290 / Apple integrated GPU
  • Storage: 530 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
  • Additional Notes: Runs natively on Apple Silicon (universal build, no Rosetta required).
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 / M2 / M3 or recent Intel i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple integrated GPU or AMD Radeon Pro
  • Storage: 530 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
  • Additional Notes: Runs natively on Apple Silicon (universal build, no Rosetta required).
